builderContract: Complete direct and transitive distribution versions and wheel SHA-256 values must be independently reviewed in windows-runtime-inputs.v1. nativeNoticeContract: build_runtime.py extracts all actual wheel LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING materials, including FFmpeg/native components, into runtime-notices. PyAV's own BSD license does not replace bundled library notices.
verification: Source/API and official release metadata read; Windows DLL loading, capture and Android/WAN use require real-platform acceptance. --stream-self-test only verifies imports and synthetic VP8 encoding.
